title: National-scale heat-exposure sentiment from Twitter data by US county
output_type: image (natural-breaks choropleth of normalised county heat exposure)
method: Parse data20000.txt into term->score (19 906 terms); case-insensitive lookup (keys lower-cased, an existing lower-case entry wins on collisions; lower-cased keys of <= 2 characters such as 'oF'/'oC' dropped); tweet value = sum of scores of lower-cased \w+ tokens; keep tweets with value != 0 and a location (geo point [lat, lon], else centroid of place bounding box); point-in-polygon to 2020 counties; per county count and mean value; min-max normalise; Jenks natural breaks (k=5) choropleth. Gold variants for the checks: authors' literal lookup (lower-cased text, cased dictionary) and exact-case lookup.
benchmark_defects: The heat vocabulary is cased ('Hot', 'Cold', 'Warm', 'Cool' exist only capitalised; 'oF' = degrees F); the authors lower-case the tweet text but not the dictionary, so these core terms never match. The gold uses a case-insensitive lookup without unit fragments; the authors' literal and an exact-case lookup are accepted as variants.
The published reference script wraps everything in `if __name__ == '__main__':` and saves heat_exposure_map.png outside pred_results.
Few weather-related tweets fall in US counties and many counties have a single tweet, so the map is noisy.
Place-tagged tweets with state/country bounding boxes are assigned to the box centroid by the authors' method (spurious county attribution); dropping them is accepted.
Domain Knowledge contains mojibake after 'Heat Exposure'.
checks: required: a one-row-per-county result covers >= 60 % of the best-matching gold variant's counties with Spearman >= 0.80
required: county value is the mean, not the sum: in a regression on [mean, (n-1)*mean] the (n-1)*mean coefficient is < 0.4 of the mean coefficient
required: counties with a non-zero value <= 1.5 x the variant's count (weather filter applied)
required: the result is min-max normalised (min <= 0.02, max >= 0.98, within [0, 1])

required: drawn polygon colours (located per county via path bounding boxes) rank-correlate with the variant's county means (|rho| >= 0.70, coverage >= 60 %); if the colours do not fit a colormap, grey (achromatic) no-data faces are dropped and the fit retried
required (the text says 'choropleth map using natural break'): natural breaks / Fisher-Jenks classification used (code inspection, comments stripped)
optional: per-county post counts computed (Spearman >= 0.8 vs gold)
